about.title: Behind every reliable system is a clear architecture
about.text: I design and implement systems that process data at scale: high-volume financial pipelines, low-latency GPU inference, and local AI agents. I specialize in Golang, Python and CUDA, with production-ready Kubernetes infrastructure. From Cochabamba to the world — remote-first.

items.q: What kind of work do you take on?
items.a: AI systems engineering: distributed backends, GPU inference, data pipelines, AI agents, and production Kubernetes. Also Flutter architecture when the product needs it.

items.q: What is your typical engagement length?
items.a: Consulting sprints of 1–4 weeks for focused problems, or retainers for ongoing systems ownership. Larger builds (like !Scarlet-class systems) are scoped per milestone.
Golang and Python for backends and AI, CUDA for parallel workloads, Kubernetes + ArgoCD for deploy, StarRocks/Elasticsearch/PostgreSQL for data. Flutter + React when UI is in scope.
Yes. Based in Cochabamba, Bolivia — remote-first with async-friendly communication and clear written architecture.
